Hi Marta — thanks for the quick packet and the attachments, very helpful. A few clarifying points from our side so procurement can configure the supplier correctly: 

1) Invoicing entity: Please invoice Redwood Inference Europe B.V. (we use the Netherlands entity for EU purchasing).

2) VAT and reverse charge: Redwood currently does have an EU VAT registration under the NL entity (we'll provide the VAT ID in a follow-up). For goods sold by your Swedish billing branch to Redwood Inference Europe B.V., we typically apply the reverse charge mechanism for B2B services and in some cross-border goods cases — but the correct treatment depends on whether the invoice is for goods shipped within the EU or for services.

3) What we need from you to complete supplier setup: 
   - Confirm which legal entity will issue the invoice (A/S in DK or AB in SE).
   - Confirm whether the invoice will include VAT (and if so, under which country rules).
   - Provide a billing contact and correct IBAN recipient name that matches the invoicing legal entity.

I’ve looped in Ben (Finance) and Laura (Procurement) to finalize PO routing and tax treatment. Ben — can you confirm the Redwood NL VAT ID we should share and whether we need vendor-side fiscal rep documentation for any EU country? Laura — procurement will want the vendor ID and the branch mapping so POs go to the right billing address.

Next step: Marta, if you can confirm the points above (entity issuing invoice + whether VAT is charged) we’ll return a definitive PO/entity mapping within 24 hours.

Thanks,
Sean

Hi Sean and team,

Thanks — quick answers below:

- Invoice issuer: Nordic Distributors AB (SE) will issue the invoice for product shipments. The DK A/S holds the master VAT registration but sales are handled via the Swedish branch.
- VAT on invoice: The Swedish invoice sample we sent currently lists no VAT (we usually apply reverse charge on B2B cross-border sales between EU companies).
- IBAN recipient: Account name is Nordic Distributors AB (matches Swedish branch).

We do not have a fiscal representative in other EU countries; we rely on the Swedish branch VAT and standard EU reverse charge flows.

I added the sample invoice (XML) for your finance team to validate field mapping. Let us know if the branch mismatch (DK parent / SE billing) will cause issues — happy to adjust how we issue the next invoice.

Hi Marta — appreciate the prompt clarification and attachments. Finance notes: 

- Redwood Inference Europe B.V. VAT ID: NL987654321B01 (please use this on the PO/invoice where reverse charge applies).
- For goods invoiced by the Swedish branch to our NL entity, reverse charge is usually appropriate for B2B supplies — the invoice should state: 

  "VAT: 0.00 - reverse charge applies under Article 194 of the EU VAT Directive. VAT to be accounted for by the recipient."

- Important mapping items for procurement/ERP: 
  - Supplier legal entity on file: Nordic Distributors A/S (master).
  - Billing branch for PO/invoice: Nordic Distributors AB (SE) — map to vendor branch ID SE-03 in our system.
  - AP remittance: IBAN (SE) must match the bank beneficiary on the XML. If beneficiary name differs from invoice legal name we will require a bank validation letter.

- Fiscal representative: Not required for us in this flow since Redwood NL is VAT-registered and reverse charge will be applied. If future shipments involve local domestic sales within an EU country where Redwood lacks registration, we may ask for additional evidence or local fiscal rep arrangements.

Next: Laura, can you create the vendor with branch mapping SE-03 and issue a PO referencing Redwood Inference Europe B.V. and NL VAT ID? Marta — once we have PO + branch mapping we’ll confirm final invoice fields.

Thanks,
